verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-device configuration, including YAML export and saving a configuration as a template, and API-based device configuration. It never documents pushing a configuration change to many robots at once or targeting by group. The only device-group or tag targeting in the pack is for Analytics queries, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can push configuration changes across many robots at once with per-group targeting
